question: g1_delete_item
answer:
Found it. The backend delete endpoint is `DELETE /api/v1/cart/{code}/product/{sku}` — the path variable must be the **product SKU**, and the facade matches line items with `shoppingCartItem.getProduct().getSku().equals(sku)`. The storefront was sending `item.id` (the cart line item's DB id) in that slot, so no line item ever matched and the backend silently deleted nothing.

Fix: `deleteFromCart` now builds `cart/{cartID}/product/{item.sku}`, which is what the API expects (cart line items in the JSON carry `sku` via `ReadableShoppingCartItem` → `ProductEntity`).

Files used:
- [cartActions.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/source/work/g1_delete_item/source/codex/2/src/redux/actions/cartActions.js:163) — the one changed
- [constant.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/source/work/g1_delete_item/source/codex/2/src/util/constant.js) and [webService.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/source/work/g1_delete_item/source/codex/2/src/util/webService.js) — URL construction/base URL
- [Cart.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/source/work/g1_delete_item/source/codex/2/src/pages/other/Cart.js:301) and [cartReducer.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/source/work/g1_delete_item/source/codex/2/src/redux/reducers/cartReducer.js) — confirmed what `item` is and how the failure surfaces
- Backend (read-only): [BasketEndpoint.java](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/pr2/sm-shop/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/shop/store/api/v1/shoppingCart/BasketEndpoint.java:286), [ShoppingCartFacadeImpl.java](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/pr2/sm-shop/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/shop/store/controller/shoppingCart/facade/ShoppingCartFacadeImpl.java:784), `ReadableShoppingCartItem`/`ProductEntity` in sm-shop-model, and `ShoppingCartAPIIntegrationTest` (its SKU-based delete test confirmed the contract).
